policy: STRICT_HUMAN_APPROVAL_ONLY: No file is promoted automatically. All defaults remain false.

candidates.purpose: Authoritative 2D point coordinates for 14 trees in study and context domains.
candidates.known_limitations: Does not include validated 3D canopy geometry or current 2026 existence proof.
candidates.required_human_approval: Confirmation of study domain coordinate bounds by Lead Researcher.

candidates.purpose: Tabular inventory of 14 trees with local and UTM Zone 43N coordinates.
candidates.known_limitations: Species reported from municipal census; unverified by botanical herbarium vouchers.
candidates.required_human_approval: Lead Researcher sign-off on inventory schema.

candidates.purpose: Catalog linking 29 KartaView and 8 Commons images to tree identifiers.
Clean regional bare-earth elevation raster with building radar artifacts stripped.
candidates.known_limitations: ~30m native cell size; cannot resolve curbs, drainage, or building thresholds.
candidates.required_human_approval: Acceptance strictly as macro-scale regional boundary condition.

candidates.purpose: Conservative-Small, Nominal, and Conservative-Large geometric bounding states.
candidates.known_limitations: Uncalibrated photo estimates; not field measured.
candidates.required_human_approval: Explicit sign-off authorizing Level 1 sensitivity testing.

candidates.purpose: Crown footprint polygons representing uncertainty envelopes.
candidates.known_limitations: Circular crown assumptions; not 3D ray-tracing meshes.
candidates.required_human_approval: Explicit sign-off authorizing Level 1 sensitivity testing.
